about.title: ABOUT ME
about.bio:
I'm a full stack developer in Manaus, Amazonas, driven by problems that don't have ready-made solutions. I work from Python/Django back ends to React interfaces, across data, infrastructure, and applied AI.

I've built computer vision for workplace safety, a management SaaS, and an AI-powered tour guide. I value readable code, lean delivery, and products that work in the real world.
